description: Implement the UCC-specific search environment and controller. This is the core module that ties together molecule processing, simulation, and RL for UCC architecture search.

RLQAS_Phase1_001.description: Molecule processing module provides MoleculeData objects for UCC search environment
RLQAS_Phase1_001.usage: Provides molecular Hamiltonian, qubit count, reference state, and FCI energy for UCC search environment

RLQAS_Phase1_002.description: Quantum simulator module provides energy evaluation for UCC circuits
RLQAS_Phase1_002.usage: Used to evaluate circuit energies during UCC search process

RLQAS_Phase1_003.description: PPO RL Agent provides reinforcement learning agent for the search process
RLQAS_Phase1_003.usage: RL agent interacts with UCCSearchEnv to learn optimal UCC circuit architectures

objectives.description: Implement UCCSearchEnv class that is gym.Env compatible as defined in RLQAS specification section 3.4
acceptance_criteria: Implement UCCSearchEnv class with required gym.Env methods: __init__, step, reset, render, close
Environment state includes circuit architecture, parameters, and energy
Action space corresponds to UCC excitation operators (single and double excitations)
Observation space includes current energy, circuit parameters, and architecture information
Environment provides reward based on energy improvement
Termination conditions include max depth, convergence threshold, or invalid actions
Observation vector should include: normalized energy, circuit parameters, architecture encoding, and step count
Action space size should equal number of available excitation operators for the molecule
Implement action masking to prevent invalid actions (exceeding max depth, duplicate excitations)
State should track current circuit depth, excitation sequence, and best energy found
Environment should handle simulator failures gracefully with appropriate error handling
Render method should display current circuit, energy, and search progress

objectives.description: Create UCCCircuitBuilder for constructing UCC circuits from excitation sequences
acceptance_criteria: Implement UCCCircuitBuilder class with build_circuit method
Support basic UCC excitation operators (single and double excitations)
Generate parameterized quantum circuits compatible with quantum simulator
Handle circuit depth limits and parameter initialization
Support circuit visualization and debugging
Excitation operators should be represented as tuples: (i,j) for single, (i,j,k,l) for double excitations
Circuit construction should map excitation operators to parameterized quantum gates
Parameter initialization should support strategies: random, zeros, normal distribution
Builder should validate excitation sequences for physical validity
Circuit output should be compatible with Task 002 quantum simulator interface
Builder should provide method to get all available excitations based on molecular orbital count
Circuit visualization should show excitation sequence and parameter values

objectives.description: Implement UCCRewardFunction for computing rewards based on energy improvements
acceptance_criteria: Implement UCCRewardFunction class with compute_reward method
Reward based on energy improvement relative to previous best
Include penalty for circuit complexity (depth, number of excitations)
Support configurable reward shaping parameters
Handle baseline energy (Hartree-Fock, current best, etc.)
Reward formula: R = (E_best - E_current) * energy_weight - depth * complexity_penalty + shaping_rewards
Energy improvement should be computed in Hartree units (appropriate scaling)
Complexity penalty should be configurable and applied per excitation operator
Support multiple baseline types: Hartree-Fock, current best, rolling average
Reward function should be differentiable-friendly for potential future extensions
Include optional shaping rewards for intermediate progress (e.g., parameter optimization success)
Handle edge cases: zero improvement, negative improvement, first evaluation

objectives.description: Create UCCSearchController to manage the complete UCC search process
acceptance_criteria: Implement UCCSearchController class with search method
Initialize RL agent, environment, and simulator
Manage training episodes and collect performance metrics
Support early stopping based on convergence threshold
Save and log search results (best circuits, energies, training history)
Controller should integrate Task 001 (molecule data), Task 002 (simulator), and Task 003 (RL agent)
Search method should accept configuration parameters: n_episodes, early_stop_threshold, etc.
Collect comprehensive metrics: episode rewards, circuit depths, energy progression, training time
Implement checkpointing: save best model periodically during training
Handle errors gracefully: simulator failures, invalid circuits, RL training instability
Provide clear progress reporting and logging for debugging
Save results in structured format for analysis and Task 005 validation

acceptance_criteria: Centralized configuration for environment, circuit builder, reward function, and controller

technical_specification.description: Detailed technical specifications for UCC search module implementation

excitation_operators.single_excitations: Tuples of the form (i, j) where i is occupied orbital index and j is virtual orbital index
excitation_operators.double_excitations: Tuples of the form (i, j, k, l) where i,k are occupied and j,l are virtual orbital indices
excitation_operators.mapping_to_quantum_gates: Each excitation operator maps to a parameterized quantum gate (typically a Givens rotation or similar)
excitation_operators.parameterization: Each excitation operator has an associated parameter theta for the rotation angle

circuit_construction.excitation_sequence: Ordered list of excitation operators applied to build the circuit
circuit_construction.parameter_vector: Vector of rotation angles for each excitation operator
circuit_construction.circuit_depth: Number of excitation operators in the circuit (circuit complexity)

observation_components: Circuit architecture (one-hot encoding of excitation operators)
state_representation.observation_dimension: Variable depending on circuit depth and number of available excitations

action_space.action_mapping: Each action index maps to a specific excitation operator from the available set
action_space.available_actions: List of valid excitation operators for the current molecule (depends on number of qubits/orbitals)
action_space.invalid_actions: Actions that would exceed max depth or create invalid circuits are masked

reward_function.baseline_energy: Can be Hartree-Fock energy or current best energy found
reward_function.shaping_rewards: Optional additional rewards for intermediate progress

episode_flow: 1. Reset environment: empty circuit, Hartree-Fock energy
2. For each step: agent selects excitation operator (action)
3. Environment adds excitation to circuit, optimizes parameters
5. Reward computed based on energy improvement

parameter_optimization.method: Can use gradient-based optimization (e.g., L-BFGS) or fixed learning rate
parameter_optimization.initialization: Parameters initialized based on config (random, zeros, normal)
parameter_optimization.optimization_frequency: Can optimize after each excitation addition or periodically

controller_responsibilities: Initialize RL agent, environment, and simulator
Manage training episodes and collect metrics
Handle early stopping based on convergence
Save best circuits and training history
